# AWG to mm2 Calculator

> Offline Android calculator that converts AWG wire gauge to square millimetres and back, from 4/0 to 40. 12 AWG is 3.309 mm2. Publisher: vitstudio, Minsk.

## Pages

- [Landing page](https://yaroshvital.github.io/awgtomm2/): working converter, price, screenshots, questions, and privacy
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vitstudio.awg_calculator): install the Android app, package com.vitstudio.awg_calculator, version 1.0.0

## Facts

- 12 AWG is 3.309 mm2. Metal diameter is 2.053 mm. Circular mils for that gauge are 6530.
- Diameter in millimetres follows ASTM B258: 0.127 × 92^((36 − n) / 39). Area is the circle of that diameter.
- The scale runs from 4/0 to 40. Screen names are 4/0, 3/0, 2/0, 1/0, then N AWG.
- AWG is the metal cross-section, not the outside diameter of an insulated cable and not the outside diameter of a strand bundle.
- The converter and the scale are free and work offline. There is no account.
- Pro is 4.99 USD once. It adds favorites, labeled pairs, compare, a nearest IEC nominal, share text, ohms per metre, metal mass, voltage drop, and the PUE current handbook (tables 1.3.4 and 1.3.5).
- The app does not pick a wire for a load.
- A rewarded video can open Pro tools for 10 minutes, up to 3 times a day, and does not replace the purchase.
- The app uses Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics and shows Yandex ads.
- Contact: yarash.vital@gmail.com
